content:
We have functional groups list. For dihydroxylation, broken: "C-C double bonds". Formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls". Let's search.


<thought>Search for a template that converts a C-C double bond into two aliphatic hydroxyls (vicinal diol) via dihydroxylation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=CC1CC(C)CC1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
